name: Fifth-generation low poly
region: Japan and the United States, then worldwide
summary: Real-time 3D at about 320×240: characters of a few hundred polygons, small textures of 64 or 128 px, vertex lighting and fog at the far plane. On one console the textures warp and the vertices jitter; on another they blur.

philosophy.core_thesis: A world of few polygons can still be entered: a box with a picture on each face becomes a room the camera walks into.
design_principles: Build characters from 300 to 1,000 triangles and rooms from simple boxes.
Use textures of 64×64 to 128×128 px, with detail painted in.
Light with per-vertex colour; bake shadows into the textures.
End the draw distance in fog of one colour.
Keep the frame at 320×240 or similar, and accept stepped edges.
Use a free or a following third-person camera.
anti_patterns: High polygon counts or smooth curves
Long clear views to the horizon

projection_and_camera.camera: Follows the player behind the shoulder, or is fixed per room.
projection_and_camera.framing: Player at 1/4 to 1/3 of the frame height; fog closes the far distance.

geometry.budget: About 300–1,000 triangles for a character; a few thousand in view.
geometry.edge_rule: Hard polygon facets; no anti-alias on the console with warp, soft blur on the console with a filter.
geometry.proportion: Large heads and hands; doors and rooms 1.5 times real scale for the camera.

surface.texture_rule: Small textures painted with brick, wood and dirt; the same texture tiles across large walls.
surface.filtering: Nearest with affine warp (PlayStation) or 3-point blur (N64).
surface.material_model: No material model; a texture times a vertex colour.

palette.strategy: Muted, slightly dirty colours in the textures; fog in one tone fills the distance.

lighting.model: Per-vertex colour; a light is a brighter set of vertex colours.
lighting.shadows: A dark blob under each character; shadows baked into textures.
lighting.atmosphere: Distance fog in one colour; few particles.
lighting.time_of_day: A change of fog colour and vertex tint.

world_and_space.scale: Rooms and doors 1.5 times real size so the camera fits.
world_and_space.interiors: Box rooms with tiled textures, few props, low ceilings for the draw distance.
world_and_space.exteriors: Small open areas walled by cliffs or buildings, closed by fog.
world_and_space.threshold: A door plays a short load animation, or a cut.

principles.rule: Build doors and corridors 1.5 times real size so the following camera fits.
Close long views with a wall, a turn or fog within about 40 m.
Make corridors at least 3 m wide for the camera.

interface.placement: Small icons and bars in the corners, 5–10% of the screen.
interface.type_and_icons: Bitmap fonts with bevels; icons as small textured quads.
interface.diegesis: On top; some maps and notes as objects in the world.

canonical_works.work: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

emotion.target_response: A strange, half-solid world: the viewer feels a place that is real enough to enter and a little uncanny.

avoid_when: The brief needs a sales-grade realistic render.

modifiers.how: Keep the polygons; push the fog, the jitter and the dark palette.
Keep the shapes; add outlines and a 2-step light ramp.

sources.title: Wikipedia: Fifth generation of video game consoles
